title: Toluene early morning peaks as potential biogenic stress signals of Mediterranean forests
content:

Ana M. Yáñez-Serrano, Mirto Lampadariou, Iolanda Filella, Joan Llusià, Roger Seco, Marcos Fernández-Martínez, Miguel Portillo-Estrada, N. Mihalopoulos, Jordi Massagué, Noemi Perez, Marjan Savadkoohi, Marco Pandolfi, Josep Peñuelas, Xavier Querol, Andrés Alastuey
Early-morning toluene peaks in 2021–2023 summers at Montseny's Mediterranean forest were linked to high temperatures and low humidity, suggesting a biogenic response to Quercus ilex drought stress.
